description: This file defines a set of validation rules for form inputs in a web application, such as required fields, character length limits, email and phone number formats, range validation, and disallowed special characters.

methods.name: required
methods.description: Validates if a value is present and not empty. Handles strings, numbers, arrays, and objects.

methods.name: shouldNotExceedCharLength
methods.description: Returns a function that checks if a string does not exceed a specified character length.

methods.name: validRange
methods.description: Returns a function that validates if a numeric string is within a specified port range.

methods.name: digitsOnly
methods.description: Validates if a string contains only digits.

methods.name: validEmailFormat
methods.description: Validates if a string matches the standard email format.

methods.name: validPhoneNumberFormat
methods.description: Validates if a string matches allowed phone number characters.

methods.name: shouldNotLessThanCharLength
methods.description: Returns a function that checks if a string has at least a certain number of characters.

methods.name: shouldNotContainSpecialChars
methods.description: Returns a function that validates if a string contains only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

ctags.name: digitsOnly
ctags.pattern: /^export const digitsOnly = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: validEmailFormat
ctags.pattern: /^export const validEmailFormat = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/
